designationHistory.name: Cold Springs Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt established the Cold Springs Reservation by Executive Order 1032; it is now Cold Springs National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cold Springs National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Wikisource transcription of Executive Order 1032 (Feb. 25, 1909): Establishing Seventeen Reservations as Preserves and Breeding Grounds for Native Birds (includes Cold Springs, Oregon)

review.note: EO 1032, 1909-02-25 (Theodore Roosevelt). One of 17 reclamation-reservoir bird reservations in EO 1032.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Cold Springs National Wildlife Refuge was one of the first refuges established in the West, created by President Theodore Roosevelt on February 25, 1909.
